# Markdown VDOM's links and code blocks ignore the theme

## Context

Two defects in the Markdown VDOM example (`examples/component/markdown`), both visible in #21975's frames and measured at 1440 × 900:
- **Links in Neo Dark.** The "neo repo" link keeps the browser's default blue, `rgb(0, 0, 238)` on the page's `rgb(13, 15, 18)`. That is 2.04:1. `dev` shows the same when Neo Dark comes from the ThemeSwitcher.
- **Code blocks in both Neo themes.** A fenced block's background follows each line's length, so the block reads like a text selection.

With #21975, the dark Portal opens this example in Neo Dark, so the unreadable link becomes the default view from there.

## The Problem

`resources/css/src/component/markdown/Component.css` styles neither links nor the code block's surface. No theme folder carries a sheet for the component: the generated theme map lists `component/markdown/Component` under `src` only. The example is its only consumer.
- Links fall back to the user agent's color.
- The parser renders a fenced block as `<pre class="neo-md-code"><code>`. The global `code:not(.hljs)` rule in `resources/css/src/Global.css` gives every `code` the inline chip's background, border and padding. Inside the `pre`, that `code` is still inline, so its background wraps each line separately.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/component/markdown/Component.mjs` (`baseCls: ['neo-markdown-vdom']`) and `src/component/markdown/Parser.mjs`, which builds the `pre.neo-md-code > code` VDOM.
- The docs-grade `Neo.component.Markdown` themes its links through `--markdown-link-color`. `resources/css/theme-neo-{dark,light}/component/Markdown.css` defines it as `var(--purple-200)` and `#3e63dd`. Those sheets load only with that class.
- No semantic token names a link color. `--sem-color-text-primary-default` is `#5472E4` in Neo Dark, 4.48:1 on the page, under AA. `--purple-200` (`#9EB1FF`) reaches 9.31:1.
- Every theme defines the global code tokens (`--global-code-background-color`, `--global-code-border`, `--global-code-border-radius`). The classic themes set them to `initial`.

## The Fix

- `resources/css/src/component/markdown/Component.css`:
  - Links read `--markdown-vdom-link-color`, falling back to `revert`.
  - `.neo-md-code` takes its surface from the global code tokens, with block padding.
  - Its `> code` child drops the inline chip's background, border and padding.
- New `resources/css/theme-neo-dark/component/markdown/Component.css` and `resources/css/theme-neo-light/component/markdown/Component.css`. Each defines `--markdown-vdom-link-color` with the docs-grade component's colors: `var(--purple-200)` in Neo Dark and `var(--purple-400)` (`#3E63DD`) in Neo Light.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] In Neo Dark and in Neo Light, the example's links reach at least 4.5:1 against the page.
- [ ] In both Neo themes, a fenced code block shows one surface across its full width, with no per-line background.
- [ ] Inline code keeps its chip.
- [ ] `MarkdownStreamingCoherenceNL.spec.mjs` passes.

## Out of Scope

- The docs-grade `Neo.component.Markdown` and its tokens.
- Classic themes: the example offers only the Neo pair, and the new rules fall back to `revert` there.
